mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" browses/filters DGCP's public /procesos API (tender/procurement processes). "Detail" fetches one or more specific processes by code, bundled with their contracts, offers received, and requested line items.

estado.title: Status filter (mode=list only, optional)
estado.description: Optional exact-match filter on process status. Observed values (DGCP's own Spanish text, not an exhaustive list): 'Proceso publicado' (open for bids), 'Sobres abiertos o aperturados', 'Proceso adjudicado y celebrado' (awarded), 'Proceso con etapa cerrada', 'Proceso desierto' (no bids), 'Cancelado'. Leave blank to include all statuses.

modalidad.title: Procurement modality filter (mode=list only, optional)
modalidad.description: Optional exact-match filter on procurement modality. Observed values: 'Comparacion de Precios', 'Compras por Debajo del Umbral', 'Contratacion Menor', 'Licitacion Publica Abreviada', 'Licitacion Publica Nacional', 'Procesos de Excepcion'. Leave blank to include all modalities.

unidadCompra.title: Buyer unit code filter (mode=list only, optional)
unidadCompra.description: Optional filter to a specific purchasing government institution's internal DGCP code (codigo_unidad_compra). Leave blank to include all buyers.

startDate.title: Start date (mode=list only, optional)
startDate.description: Optional publish-date range filter, inclusive. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.title: End date (mode=list only, optional)
endDate.description: Optional publish-date range filter, inclusive. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

procesoCode.title: Process code (mode=list: optional exact filter; mode=detail: single code)
procesoCode.description: In mode=list, an optional exact-match filter on a single process code (codigo_proceso). In mode=detail, a single process code to fetch full detail for -- combine with procesoCodes for multiple.

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many records this run returns. The API is paged internally (max 1000 rows/page), so this actor makes as many requests as needed up to this cap or until no further pages are available.

fetchDetail.title: Fetch full detail for each list row (mode=list only)
fetchDetail.description: When enabled, each list row is enriched with that process's contracts, offers received, and requested line items -- up to 3 extra requests per row, so runs take longer.

procesoCodes.title: Process codes (mode=detail only)
procesoCodes.description: Multiple process codes to fetch full detail for in one run. Find codes from a 'list' mode run's codigo_proceso field.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many process code lookups to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. This target answered cleanly on a plain datacenter-class connection during recon -- no proxy is required, but Residential is offered for reliability on longer/bulk runs.
